gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YE-AFTER EFFECTS - OKUSHA
Inguqulo 9.2.8  -  Okthoba 2026
================================================================================

Ipanela manje ikhuluma IZILIMI EZI-132, kunamatimu amasha e-DEMON SLAYER anenkemba
esika izinkinobho ozicindezelayo, kanye nokulungiswa okumbalwa kokuklama ne-Windows.

NGAPHAMBI KOKUQALA
- Faka phezu kwenguqulo yakho yamanje usebenzisa isifaki sakho se-ZXP esejwayelekile,
  bese uqala kabusha i-After Effects kanye.
- Izilungiselelo zakho, itimu, ama-preset nama-expression owagcinile kuyagcinwa.

OKUSHA: IPANELA NGEZILIMI EZI-132
- Izilungiselelo ze-Flex > ULIMI manje lubhala phansi izilimi ezi-132, kanye
  nebhokisi yokusesha. Khetha olunye bese ipanela lonke liyashintsha: amathebhu, izinkinobho, izeluleko, imiyalezo.
- Ulimi ngalunye luhunyushwe yi-AI kusukela kupanela lesiNgisi, hhayi igama negama.
  Amagama obona ephrojekthini yakho (amagama ama-layer, amagama emiphumela)
  asala esiNgisini ukuze aqhubeke ehambisana ne-After Effects.
- Ifasitela le-"okusha" nalo liyahunyushwa, kusukela kulokhu kukhishwa.

OKUSHA: AMATIMU E-DEMON SLAYER
- Izilungiselelo ze-Flex > UMKHETHI WETIMU ineqembu elisha le-DEMON SLAYER elinamatimu ayi-11:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen no-Kokushibo.
- Hambisa igundane phezu kwepanela bese into yetimu iyalandela: amanzi,
  amalangabi, umbani, izimvemvane, amaqabunga ezimbali, inkungu nokunye.
  Uma igundane limisa, iyanyamalala kancane.
- Chofoza inkinobho bese inkemba yalowo mlingiswa iyayisika. Gcina inkinobho
  yesokunxele icindezelwe iqhubeke isika; yibambe cishe imizuzwana engu-2.5 iqhume.
- Yenzelwe ukuhlala ilula: imiphumela iqhuba kuphela uma uhambisa noma uchofoza,
  futhi iba lula yodwa kumakhompyutha ahamba kancane. Vala IMIPHUMELA YENDAWO
  kuMkhethi wetimu ukuze ugcine imibala kuphela.

KUSHINTSHILE: IZINKINOBHO EZISICABA KUYO YONKE ITIMU
- Izinkinobho ezisebenzayo nezinkulu emathimini agqamile azisasebenzisi i-gradient
  enombala osuka phezulu uye phansi. Manje zinombala owodwa osicaba nokukhanya
  okuthambile, ngakho zibukeka zihlanzekile futhi zifundeka kangcono.

KULUNGISIWE
- Ikhadi lelayisense nefasitela le-"okusha" kwakungavuleka elilodwa phezu kwelinye.
  Manje akwenzi lokho, futhi ibheji ye-BUYEKEZA ayisazimbozi izinkinobho
  ezingaphezulu epanelini.
- Ku-USAYIZI WE-UI 125% no-150%, amanye amafasitela (njengelithi Izilungiselelo
  ze-Flex) ayengaba made kunepanela, ngakho inkinobho yawo yokuvala yayingabonakali.
  Manje wonke amafasitela ayangena kuwo wonke amasayizi.
- Windows: i-AutoCaptions ibingathi "I-NVIDIA DRIVER IDALA KAKHULU KUWO-GPU
  CAPTIONS" emakhadini nakuma-driver amasha (uchungechunge lwe-RTX 40 no-50). Manje
  ifunda ukusekelwa kwe-CUDA kwe-driver ngendlela efanele futhi isebenzisa i-GPU yakho.

AKUSHINTSHANGA
- Ilayisense, ukwenza kusebenze nazo zonke izixhumanisi kusebenza njengakuqala nje.
- Wonke amanye amathebhu namathuluzi asebenza njengoba kwakunjalo ku-9.2.7.
================================================================================

ult.message:
FLEX ULTIMATE YE-PREMIERE PRO - OKUSHA
Inguqulo 2.2.8  -  Okthoba 2026

Ama-caption e-CAPTION STACK manje angamathempulethi e-Motion Graphics ANGAHLELWA
anomhleli wangempela, kunge-AUDIO STUDIO entsha ne-MAKA AMABEAT E-AUDIO, ipanela
ikhuluma IZILIMI EZI-132, USAYIZI WE-UI ufika ku-ULTIMATE, futhi kunamatimu amasha e-DEMON SLAYER.

NGAPHAMBI KOKUQALA
- Faka phezu kwenguqulo yakho yamanje usebenzisa isifaki sakho se-ZXP esejwayelekile,
  bese uqala kabusha i-Premiere Pro kanye.
- Izilungiselelo zakho, itimu nama-preset kuyagcinwa.

OKUSHA: CAPTION STACK - AMA-CAPTION AHLELEKAYO (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Ama-caption manje afakwa njengamathempulethi e-Motion Graphics ahlelekayo
  (Okuphumayo > MOGRT EHLELEKAYO, okuyisinqumo esisha ku-Premiere Pro 2026). Ngemva
  kokufaka, shintsha noma yiliphi igama, ifonti, umbala, usayizi, isikhundla, ukukhanya,
  umugqa wangaphandle, ibhokisi, i-animation noma isikhathi epanelini le-Essential Graphics le-Premiere.
- Okuphumayo > IZITHOMBE kusafaka igama ngalinye njengesithombe esinokubukeka okufanayo,
  uma ukukhetha lokho.
- Amathempulethi eza nepanela. Akukho okufanele ukulande.

OKUSHA: UMHLELI WE-CAPTION STACK
- I-preview manje ibonisa ifreyimu yangempela yevidiyo yakho ngaphansi kwe-caption ngayinye.
- Donsa i-caption ukuyihambisa, sebenzisa isiqephu ukushintsha usayizi nethonsi
  eliphezulu ukuyijikisa, chofoza kabili igama ukulihlela. I-CAPTION ELIPHELELE
  ihambisa wonke amagama ndawonye, IGAMA ELILODWA lihambisa igama elilodwa.
- Khetha ukuthi ushintsho lusebenza kuwo wonke ama-caption noma kule caption kuphela,
  futhi ugcine amalayout akho ukuze uwasebenzise futhi.
- Imibukeko emisha ye-GLOW eyi-10: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow ne-Superb.

OKUSHA: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Khetha iklip yomsindo, khetha umphumela bese ucindezela SEBENZISA. Konke
  kusebenza kukhompyutha yakho.
- Ama-preset angu-30 ngokuchofoza kanye: Underwater, Bass Boost, i-reverb ye-Room / Hall /
  Cathedral / Plate, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse nokunye. Beka
  imiphumela eminingi ngangokunjalo ofuna, uyihlele kabusha noma uvale owodwa.
- I-Reverb igcina umsila wayo: umsindo uyaqhubeka ngaphezu kokuphela kweklip, futhi
  ubekwa ukuze kungabikho lutho kuthayimulayini yakho olubhalwa phezulu.
- Amathuluzi: Isisusi Sengxolo, Ukuthuthukisa Izwi, Ubukhulu Bomsindo (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Isisusi se-Hum, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Isivinini
  ne-Pitch, Noise Gate, Ukukhipha Umsindo.
- I-STEMS MAKER ihlukanisa ingoma ibe izwi nomculo (noma ama-stem angu-4). Ilanda
  imodeli yayo ngesikhathi sokuqala futhi ikubuze kuqala.
- I-PREVIEW ikuvumela ukuthi uzwe cishe imizuzwana engu-8 ngeswishi ye-Original /
  Processed. Umphumela uya kuthrekhi lomsindo olukhululekile futhi iklip yakho
  yoqobo iyathulisiwe, ayisoze isulwe.

OKUSHA: MAKA AMABEAT E-AUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > MAKA AMABEAT E-AUDIO)
- Khetha iklip yomculo kuthayimulayini bese ucindezela MAKA AMABEAT: i-Flex
  ithola ama-beat futhi yengeze ama-marker e-sequence kuwo, ukuze ukusika kwakho
  kuhambisane ngqo nomculo.
- Khetha ZONKE ama-hit, ama-KICKS noma ama-SNARES, setha ukuzwela, futhi
  maka wonke ama-beat noma i-beat ngayinye yesibili noma yesine.
- SUSA AMA-MARKER E-BEAT kususa kuphela ama-marker engezwe yi-Flex. Isebenza
  kukhompyutha yakho.

OKUSHA: IPANELA NGEZILIMI EZI-132
